Name: Kenneth's Potion Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Potion Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A little potion shop for your farm. Potions, tonics, and elixirs in 5 small shops, for when you want a quick drink before heading out.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it is[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A small shop building for your farm. You ask Robin to build it, and after a few days, you have your own place to browse potions.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Inside, there are 5 counters. Each counter opens a different shop, with its own set of potions. Walk up, take a look, and see what fits how you play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]42 potions, tonics, and elixirs to start with, spread across the 5 shops. Some are light and fizzy, some are earthy and calm, and a few are the kind you save for a long day in the mines.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check each shop in game when you have time. No rush.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to get it[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Talk to Robin and build Kenneth's Potion Shop on your farm. It takes 7 days to build.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Once it is up, just walk inside and check the counters. You buy with gold, no bars or gems needed.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Build the shop with Robin.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Walk inside and check the 5 counters.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Start the game, ask Robin to build the shop, and check it after 7 days.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. This is the base shop. The other Kenneth's potion sets - like Prism, Vortex, and the rest - add more potions to these same 5 shops. You can add them anytime, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
